Scientific and methodological documentation

This reference documents the scientific behavior of BioMolExplorer 2.2.0 as implemented in the current source. It is the English companion to the fully detailed Portuguese scientific reference; equations, defaults, limitations, implementation paths and bibliography are identical.

Implemented method map

AreaExact active implementation
ADMET descriptorsRDKit MW, TPSA, Wildman-Crippen logP, HBD/HBA, rotatable bonds, QED, fraction Csp3, rings, charge, fragments and aromatic proportion in src/caad/admet.py
Screening rulesExact Lipinski, Veber and extended rule-of-three violation counts; ESOL-style and Potts-Guy-style equations documented in the Portuguese reference
BBB/HIA/P-gpExplicit local ellipse/penalty heuristics; labels are not probabilities
ADMET-AIADMET-AI 2.x, include_physchem=False, no DrugBank percentile, batches of 256, raw provider endpoints prefixed ML_, no generic probability threshold
Morganradius 2, 2048 bits by default, chirality and feature invariants enabled, bond types disabled
MACCSRDKit public 166-key definition in a 167-position vector (bit zero unused)
PharmacophoreRDKit Gobbi Pharm2D topological feature-pair/triplet fingerprint
SimilarityTanimoto, Dice, Cosine, Sokal, Russel, Rogot-Goldberg, AllBit, Kulczynski, McConnaughey, Asymmetric and Braun-Blanquet; values rounded to 3 decimals before thresholding
Consensustarget-balanced ECR rank quantiles, tau=0.1, explicit target coverage and missing-rank penalty; no z-score or min-max
DOCK 6 footprintEngine-produced residue van der Waals/electrostatic footprint and reference FPS; BioMolExplorer validates and displays rather than recomputes energies
3D contactsConservative geometry for H-bond, hydrophobic, pi-parallel, pi-T and van der Waals contacts; no salt-bridge classifier
NetworksUnweighted undirected degree, centralities, PageRank 0.85, k-core, clustering, triangles and seeded Louvain

Core equations

For active-bit sets A and B, with a=|A|, b=|B|, c=|A intersection B|: Tanimoto=c/(a+b-c), Dice=2c/(a+b), and Cosine=c/sqrt(ab).

For each engine/target group, tied observations occupying zero-based indices s through e-1 among N observations receive:

q = ((s + e - 1) / 2) / max(N - 1, 1)
relevance = exp(-q / 0.1)
engine_factor = coverage * exp(-sum_target(q) / (T * 0.1))
consensus = (vina_factor + dock6_factor) / 2

Missing target ranks use q=1 in the penalty. At least one target-compound pair must be present in both engines. repulsion_weight is currently a compatibility no-op. This is a ranking policy, not a calibrated binding probability.

The implemented local screening equations are:

ESOL_logS = 0.26121066137801696 - 0.0066138847738667125 MW
            - 0.7416739523408995 WLOGP + 0.003451545565957996 RB
            - 0.42624840441316975 AromaticProportion
logKp = -6.3 + 0.71 WLOGP - 0.0061 MW

3D geometry and explicit omissions

Hydrogen bonds require D-A <= 4.1 A, explicit D-H between 0.6 and 1.25 A, and D-H-A > 100 degrees. Hydrophobic contacts use 4.0 A. Aromatic centers use 5.5 A, offset at most 2 A, and normal angles at most 30 degrees (parallel) or at least 60 degrees (T-shaped). van der Waals gaps must lie between -0.4 and 0.5 A relative to RDKit radii.

The current repository does not implement PCA, t-SNE, UMAP, AUC-ROC, enrichment factor, salt bridges, cation-pi, halogen bonds or metal coordination. These capabilities must not be inferred from generic scientific terminology.

References and full traceability

The complete bibliography and method-by-method interpretation are maintained in the Portuguese scientific reference. Source anchors include src/caad/admet.py, src/biomolexplorer/admet_predictors.py, src/kernel/descriptors.py, src/biomolexplorer/consensus_model.py, src/biomolexplorer/footprints.py, src/biomolexplorer/docking_interactions.py and src/biomolexplorer/network_analysis.py.
